title: Synthesis and structural and spectroscopic properties of a cyanido-bridged mixed-valence compound [Fe–NC–Ru–CN–Fe]
abstract: Five cyanide-bridged compounds                     trans                     -[Cp(dppe)Fe(NC)Ru                                            II                                          (py)                                            4                                          (CN)Fe(dppe)Cp][PF                                            6                                          ]                                                                     n                                                                 and                     trans                     -[Cp(dppe)Fe(NC)Ru                                            II                                          (MeOpy)                                            4                                          (CN)Fe(dppe)Cp][PF                                            6                                          ]                                                                     n                                                                 were systematically synthesized and characterized.
